description: FREE headline settlement pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the signature and expected fields are well-formed; no chain read is performed and no verdict is returned. The full signed report is the paid settlement_verify call.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

expected.description: The expected settlement fields: payTo (wallet), amountUnits (USDC micro-units), and optionally tokenAccount and memo.

signature.description: The one Solana transaction signature to verify. Read live from the chain at call time; never stored.

name: settlement_precheck
